primitive unification, clause entry, local calls, products, nested catch, public transitions, and every finite prefix preserve cumulative substitutions; copied-ball stability plus lineage makes successful pre-unwind selection constructively recoverable after unwind, the selection/mismatch split cannot get stuck, and an explicit aliasing counterexample proves ball stability is independently necessary

local throw/1 materializes under the throw-time bindings, injectively alpha-copies every finite-term variable into a globally fresh interval, preserves sharing and separation, cannot be captured by old substitution domains or values, discards the residual conjunction, and has exact uncaught and caught finite traces; four concrete anti-vacuity witnesses reject copy-before-materialization, alias loss, variable collapse, and value-hidden high-water collision
